subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native provenance contract should durable OpenClaw memory use across memory-core, QMD/builtin memory search, MEMORY.md promotion, memory-lancedb, Memory Wiki bridge inputs, and review/edit flows?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but source authority, durable schema shape, merge/edit semantics, and cross-plugin ownership need maintainer product direction before implementation.

options.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

options.title: Settle Schema First
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 to decide the canonical record/revision model first, then implement this provenance layer on that schema.

options.title: Keep Provenance Wiki-Only For Now
options.body: Treat Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for the moment.

recommendation.title: Define Native Provenance Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision primarily extends the shared memory host SDK and active-memory contract boundary where steipete has the strongest history signal.
